sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER 1. Accused no.1 in Spl.S.C.No.128/2024 pending before the Court of Additional District & Sessions Judge, FTSC-I, Chikkaballapura, arising out of Crime No.114/2024 registered by Chintamani Town Police, Station, Chikkaballapura District, for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC, Sections 4, 12 & 17 of the POCSO Act, 2012, and Section 9 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, is before this Court under Section 439 of Cr.PC seeking regular bail.
2.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioner and learned HCGP for respondent No.1.
Respondent No.2 though served in the matter, has remained unrepresented before this Court.

3. FIR in Crime No.114/2024 was registered by Chintamani Town Police Station, Chikkaballapura District, against petitioner herein and another initially for the offences punishable under NC:
2024:KHC:51326 Sections 363, 366 IPC and Section 12 of the POCSO Act, 2012, on the basis of the first information dated 19.06.2024 received from the mother of the victim girl.

entities.text: Chintamani Town Police Station, Chikkaballapura District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: During the course of investigation of the case, petitioner herein was arrested on 19.06.2024.
Investigation of the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed against two persons.
Petitioner is arrayed as accused no.1 in the charge sheet.
Bail application filed by the petitioner before the jurisdictional Sessions Court in Spl.S.C.No.128/2024 was rejected on 26.09.2024.
Therefore, he is before this Court.
4. Learned Counsel for petitioner submits that petitioner and the victim girl were in love and they are married.
Petitioner is aged about 20 years.
He is in custody for the last six months.
In the first information, there is no allegation of committing sexual assault.
However, the offence punishable under Section 12 of the POCSO Act was invoked subsequently for extraneous reasons since the petitioner and the victim belong to different castes.

Accused no.2 has been granted anticipatory bail Nikhil vs State Of Karnataka on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103911351/
2 by this Court in Crl.P.No.11591/2024 disposed of on 23.11.2024.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.
He submits that victim girl is a minor aged about 14 years and petitioner after marrying her, has committed the heinous offence.

Accordingly,
he prays to dismiss the petition.
6. In the first information, it is averred that on 18.06.2024 accused Nos.1 and 2 had taken the minor daughter of first informant out of the house on the guise of providing her certain eatables.
Thereafter, first informant's daughter had not returned home and the efforts made by the first informant to trace the victim girl had failed.
On 19.06.2024 at about 9.30 a.m., accused no.2 allegedly informed the first informant that her daughter was near Azadav Chowka at Chintamani.

Immediately, the first informant and her husband went to the said spot and found her daughter and on inquiry, she informed that the petitioner had taken her along with accused no.2 and had kissed her and thereafter, they had stayed in the house of accused no.2.
Since the victim girl was crying in the house of accused no.2, he had brought her and left her near Azadav Chowka at Chintamani.
It is specifically stated in the first information that victim girl had informed her parents that she was not physically assaulted by anybody.
It is under this NC: 2024:KHC:51326 circumstance, FIR was initially registered for the offences punishable under Section 363, 366 of IPC and Section 12 of POCSO Act.
After investigation in the case is completed, charge sheet has been now filed against the accused persons for the aforesaid offences.

7. So far as the petitioner herein is concerned, the allegation against him is that he had kissed the victim girl in the house of accused no.2, and thereafter, had married the minor girl in the said house.
Undisputedly, petitioner and the victim girl were in love with each other.

In the first information,
there is no allegation of sexual assault and it is specifically stated that victim girl was not physically assaulted by anybody.
Accused no.2 has been granted anticipatory bail by this Court in Crl.P.No.11591/2024 disposed of on 23.11.2024.

Having regard to the aforesaid aspects of the matter and also considering the fact that petitioner is an youngster aged 20 years, and he has no other criminal antecedents, I am of the opinion that petitioner's prayer for grant of regular bail requires to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following:
NC: 2024:KHC:51326 8.
The petition is allowed.
